name: AniList Metadata
overview: Supplies AniList anime metadata, images, cast and crew, tags, studios, relations, recommendations and broadcast times for the `anilist` metadata source, through Shoko's metadata provider contract.

releases.release_notes:
Rate limits, spent quotas and the server-error breaker are reported as suspensions, so the server and the Web UI can show why AniList's jobs are waiting. The back-off itself is unchanged. A server error that carries `Retry-After` now lengthens the server-error wait instead of also reporting a rate limit.

Built against the abstractions `6.0.0-alpha.101` release.

Requires Shoko Server with abstractions `6.0.0-alpha.101`.

The plugin's configuration is now marked as a metadata provider configuration, so it registers with the provider rather than as a standalone configuration. Rebuilt against the abstractions `6.0.0-alpha.100` release, where the interfaces that tie a configuration to its provider moved into `Shoko.Abstractions.Config`.

Requires Shoko Server with abstractions `6.0.0-alpha.100`.

Cast and crew are now switched on and off with the provider's `creator` and `character` kinds, both off by default, while studios stay on; the old download settings are gone. Airings are stored by their episode number, capped at AniList's episode count. Auto-linking handles anime with an unknown episode count better, using the next airing and the full schedule, and searches by the year of the regular broadcast.

Rebuilt against the abstractions `6.0.0-alpha.99` release.

Requires Shoko Server with abstractions `6.0.0-alpha.99`.

The plugin is now called AniList, and it fills in more of what Shoko shows. Anime, staff, characters and studios link to their pages on AniList. Staff, characters and studios can also be refreshed on their own when Shoko asks for one, for example a person who so far only appears as a name in a credit; an anime's refresh still writes them in full. The plugin also has its own icon and thumbnail now.

Rebuilt against the abstractions `6.0.0-alpha.98` release.

Requires Shoko Server with abstractions `6.0.0-alpha.98`.

First release. Supplies AniList anime metadata to Shoko through its metadata provider contract, for the `anilist` metadata source: titles and overviews, images, cast and crew, tags, studios, relations, recommendations and broadcast times.

Series are matched by searching AniList for the anime's titles and scoring the results by title and air date, following the first prequel where that helps. Shoko's auto-linker then decides what to link. Auto-linking is off until an admin turns it on for the `anilist` source.

Requires Shoko Server with abstractions `6.0.0-alpha.95`.
